method: Comment/string-stripped lexical index. Constructor candidates require open Lui_elements or a direct module alias and a following argument. Locally shadowed unqualified names are excluded. Named arguments are the same-delimiter-depth leading labels; wrappers, raw writers and all UI labels are retained separately. This is source evidence, not a typechecked whole-program call graph. Native-shared means explicitly copied by native/dune; a native-twin may override web source.

index_schema.files: Array indices are file IDs; records include repository-relative path, native build scope and SHA-256.
index_schema.constructor_sites: [file ID, 1-based line, constructor name, leading named argument names]
index_schema.ui_named_argument_lexemes: argument name -> file ID -> 1-based lines; may include non-LUI helper labels, so this is a conservative evidence index, not a resolved prop contract.
